phase: formula-pass (blind; stage-A packet only; no claims seen)

formulaIdentity.normalization: One entry per ingredient; normalized positions = packet positions (ID-2).

surfactants.definingAnionic: Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (strong anionic, ether/sulfonate type)

wLine.plausibility: Piroctone Olamine @7: (i) SLES @2 before; (ii) Menthol @8 is not a surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax

formulaFacts.mildBase: not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffers Lauryl Glucoside @3 and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @4, no reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful system - prominent cationic starch Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride @6 (before the active and fragrance). Nothing else conditions (no silicone, lipid, refatter, pearlizer or humectant), so low is the realistic neighbor (Section 5).

weightPotential.persistence: low-to-moderate - single polysaccharide cationic, no reinforcing route
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A single deposition family without a reinforcing route faces a moderate reset (W2: can remain low).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: one cationic starch alone, no silicone, lipid, protein or refatter to converge with it, against a buffered SLES chassis; one route kind is a clue, not a moderate floor (6.6).
weightPotential.rationale: Low: single cationic polymer vs moderate reset (6.4, 6.6, W2). Neighbor moderate.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Piroctone Olamine @7 and Menthol @8 point to an anti-dandruff/scalp role if positioned
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): no claim direction; dandruff active present. Placeholder general until claims.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL: default regular; treatment if a moderate/high dandruff claim (supported active, U3); frequent possible with frequency wording (U2).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL: CSA not met - no listed E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route is prominent and MB is excluded (prominent SLES @2). Counter-signal: prominent Menthol @8. A sensitive/dry claim would fail its formula gate.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: Piroctone Olamine @7 in the complete INCI (Section 11).

uncertainties: Conditioning moderate vs low: a single prominent cationic starch is read as one meaningful system.
